urdu: نیر حسین کی کپتانی میں کمبائنڈ سروسز نے دوبارہ فرسٹ کلاس کرکٹ کا آغاز کب کیا؟
english: When did Combined Services resume first-class cricket under the captaincy of Naeer Hussain?
roman_1: Naeer Hussain ki captaincy mein Combine Services ne dobara first-class cricket ka aghaz kab kia?
roman_2: Naeer Hussain ki qiyadat mein Combined Services ne dobara first-class cricket ka aghaz kab kiya?
roman_3: Naeer Hussain ka captain banne par Combined Services ne first-class cricket ka dobara aghaz kab kya?
